content: flate2 1.1.11 backends: miniz_oxide (default, pure Rust), zlib (system libz-sys, current rustkmer backend), zlib-rs (fastest overall per docs, pure Rust + some unsafe, dep zlib-rs ^0.6.7), zlib-ng (needs C compiler, libz-ng-sys), zlib-ng-compat (silently falls back to stock zlib if graph requests it), cloudflare_zlib unsupported; precedence zlib-ng > zlib-rs > miniz_oxide; no parallel decompression anywhere in flate2; MultiGzDecoder reads all concatenated members and errors on trailing non-gzip bytes.
